assertions.claim: After an elderly head bump, blood usually accumulates only by the third week; at the time of impact there may be nothing, and the person may not remember.
assertions.cn_span: 血通常到第三周才积起来

assertions.claim: Chronic subdural hematoma: post-op recurrence up to 33%, mortality up to 32%, good overall outcome 24% in those over 90.
assertions.cn_span: 术后复发率能到 33%、病死率能到 32%

assertions.claim: Global incidence 3.39–39.1/100k/year, rising with age, can triple after 80; top causes trauma/falls, then long-term alcohol, anticoagulants, violence.
If an elderly person suddenly becomes confused, walks unsteadily, is sleepy, or one side weakens — first ask about falls/head bumps in the past 2–3 months, then CT.
assertions.cn_span: 先倒回去问这两三个月摔没摔过头，再去做 CT

assertions.claim: Higher risk in the elderly on aspirin, clopidogrel, warfarin or novel oral anticoagulants, and in heavy drinkers; don't dismiss as dementia or old-stroke sequelae.
assertions.cn_span: 吃阿司匹林、氯吡格雷、华法林或新型口服抗凝药的老人风险更高
